    Model parameters are generic placeholders and the weather is a synthetic annual cycle, so read the shapes and the timing effects, not the absolute yields. The best choice is the highest-yield combination on a coarse grid of sowing dates, varieties and nitrogen rates for the current weather year, preferring less nitrogen when yields are within 1%.
